_comment: SCH1 (spec/rules/dom.md): measurement sites in packages/rendering runtime src. Allowed kinds: geometry module (GeometryReader G1/G4) or a site that cannot move onto GeometryReader. Each entry needs file, enclosing symbol, and a reason that names why this site cannot move. Remove an entry in the same PR that deletes or reschedules the last call in that symbol.

entries.reason: M3 visual line-start needs the collapsed-Range caret-x the conformance ink probe uses; GeometryReader.caretRect disagrees with Firefox by one offset at a bidi space. Already inside measureWithRoot — measureVisualLineEdge:322 wraps the caretXAt/caretYAt callers, so this is the checker's call-chain blind spot, not an unscheduled read.
EditContext characterboundsupdate must return a DOMRect[] for the requested range in the same callback; GeometryReader G1 forbids per-character spans.
Pointer-to-atom offset is returned into the same hit-test; GeometryReader has no atom-host rect API.
Pointer-down boundary side is returned into the same click handler; the selection redesign deletes this module.
elementFromPoint plus nearest-block walk run inside the pointer hit-test that must return a node now; the selection redesign deletes this module.
G4 past-document clamp compares the first/last block box to clientY in the same pointer hit-test that must return a point now; the selection redesign deletes this module.
caretPositionFromPoint types and fallbacks feed a synchronous pointer-to-point API; the selection redesign deletes this module.
elementFromPoint typeof guard inside the inline-atom pointer hit-test; the selection redesign deletes this module.
Range.getBoundingClientRect type used by the selection-bridge caret helper; the selection redesign deletes this module.
Range.getClientRects type for multi-rect offset mapping consumed by GeometryReader until the selection redesign replaces the seam.
Per-character Range.getBoundingClientRect for offset-from-point; the selection redesign deletes this module.
Empty-inline caret uses the inline host box inside the selection-bridge offset mapper; the selection redesign deletes this module.
SCH1 geometry — GeometryReader G1 Range.getClientRects type.
SCH1 geometry — GeometryReader caretFromElementRect uses the host box.
SCH1 geometry — GeometryReader elementRect uses the host box.
SCH1 geometry — GeometryReader G4 caretPositionFromPoint type.
SCH1 geometry — GeometryReader pointAt inside-block test uses block boxes.
SCH1 geometry — GeometryReader G4 nearest-block-edge uses block boxes.
Host chrome click-above/below compares each text-block box to clientY in the same pointer handler; GeometryReader.pointAt (G4) is the scheduled replacement once this host path is wired.
HTML5 dragstart must size the ghost from the source atom box before setDragImage; not a document block.
Menu chrome width/height is the mounted surface box, not a GeometryReader document query; already inside measureWithRoot.
Scroll-into-view compares the suggestion span and its scroll container in the same turn; neither is a GeometryReader block.
Visibility filter reads each suggestion span box; those are decoration hosts, not blocks.
Control placement subtracts the editor-content host box; GeometryReader has no element-rect API.
Popover open path sets position from the suggestion element box in the same callback; not a block id.
Toolbar prefers the live window.Selection range so it can place before a root/GeometryReader is available; resolveSelectionRect is the GeometryReader fallback already.
Floating prompt tracks the live window.Selection range while the user is still selecting; snapshot rangeRects would lag the native range.
Flip/shift reads the prompt surface, content host, and scroll container boxes — chrome, not document blocks.
Inserted-mode spacing needs the mounted surface height in the same layout effect that writes marginTop.
elementFromPoint finds which editor root is under the pointer before any GeometryReader exists for that root.
Dragenter/over hit-tests the editor root and content boxes; GeometryReader has no element-rect API. Already inside measureWithRoot.
Flip/shift measures the toolbar's own mounted box after it is in the DOM.
HTML5 dragstart sizes the ghost from the source block element before setDragImage.
